statement: Tip sags no more than 0.5 mm at rated load
rationale: past ~0.5 mm the droop is visible against a level shelf edge; this is a product decision, not a physics one

mechanism.how: Euler-Bernoulli tip deflection of the arm as a cantilever under the rated 15 N, from the model's section and PETG's conservative modulus, once the arm is shown slender enough for that beam theory
